name: 白眉田雞

similarSpecies.distinction: Substantive identification/range/conservation read. Adult Rallus indicus (Brown-cheeked Rail, HKBWS Eastern Water Rail),23–29cm, long slightly decurved bill dull red base/lower mandible dark culmen/tip, dull pink-red legs. Brown upperparts black feather centres from crown/nape to mantle. Grey blue-grey face/breast/upper belly variably brown washed, dark lores/eye stripe contrasting dull grey supercilium and usually extensive WHITE THROAT. Black-white flank/lower belly bars and black barred white undertail. Monotypic split from R.aquaticus; retain runtime English/Chinese/scientific names. Breeds N Mongolia/E Siberia/NE China/Sakhalin/NJapan; winters NE India/Bangladesh/Myanmar/NThailand/NLaos/ESEChina incl Hainan/Taiwan/Korea/SJapan. HK scarce winter marsh visitor. LC decreasing.
Adult much larger waterhen with entirely white face/breast/belly, slate upperparts and rust undertail unlike small crake two separate white face stripes and buff rear. LC.

rangeMap.note: Adult15–20cm slimmer longer-legged than Ruddy-breasted Crake, long toes jacana-like. Pale grey underparts buff towards rear, pale straw streaked upperparts, yellowish bill/legs, dark grey crown blackish eye area, prominent WHITE SUPERCILIUM and LONG WHITE SUBOCULAR stripe billbase below eye to earcoverts. Monotypic continental SEAsia/Philippines/Sunda islands/NewGuinea/N Australia and Pacific islands to W Central Polynesia. Few records SChina incl W Yunnan/S Guangxi/HK/Hainan/Taiwan. HK accidental; LC population trend UNKNOWN (not stable). Full-world partial native-country overview only; not complete range, whole-country occupancy or exact occurrence/season polygons.
